HomePage.featuresSubtitle: Everything you need to forecast and optimize your air conditioning wattage efficiently.
HomePage.feature1Desc: Seamlessly synchronize real-time wattage data directly from your IoT devices.
HomePage.feature2Desc: Deploy custom machine learning models specific to your hardware specifications.
HomePage.feature3Desc: Track energy usage and predictions through our comprehensive dashboard interface.
HomePage.processSubtitle: From input to actionable insight in three simple steps.
HomePage.step1Desc: Automatically collect and synchronize real-time electrical metrics from your connected IoT sensors. This ensures our model runs on accurate, live data without manual entry.
HomePage.step2Desc: Our advanced CART Decision Tree model processes the incoming metrics against comprehensive historical energy patterns, instantly generating highly accurate wattage forecasts tailored to your specific hardware setup.
HomePage.step3Desc: Review the detailed wattage forecasts through our intuitive dashboard. Identify usage spikes and implement data-driven strategies to significantly optimize your daily electrical consumption.

outlier.label: Outlier Detection
outlier.question: Detection and Removal of Outliers
outlier.p1: Outlier data is a value that deviates significantly from normal patterns. The author uses the Interquartile Range (IQR) method on the variables Current (I), Voltage (V), and Active Power (P) to detect them.
outlier.step1: Determine Quartile 1 (Q₁) and Quartile 3 (Q₃) of the dataset.
outlier.step4Desc: If there is data outside the bounds, it is flagged or removed.

missing.label: Missing Data
missing.question: Handling Missing Data
missing.p1: Because the system transmits data over Wi-Fi, there are sometimes gaps. Handling scenarios:
missing.largeGapDesc: Interpolation is no longer accurate. Data during this period is removed or analyzed separately.

groundTruth.label: Ground Truth
groundTruth.question: Validation against Ground Truth
groundTruth.p1: Sensor readings are cross-checked with standard measuring instruments (multimeter/clamp meter) to ensure their calibration does not drift.
groundTruth.actionDesc: If Error > 5%, the data is flagged for investigation / recalibration.

timeCheck.label: Time Consistency
timeCheck.question: Time Consistency Check
timeCheck.p1: Since this regression is time-series based, the sequence of data capture times is crucial.
timeCheck.actionDesc: There must be no duplicate or backward times. If a temporal anomaly (system restart) is found, the data is discarded.

sanity.label: Sanity Check
sanity.question: Value Validity Check (Sanity Check)
sanity.p1: Verification of basic electrical logic on the reading results.
sanity.rule1: Electrical values (P, V, I) must not be zero or negative simultaneously in normal operation.
sanity.rule2: If current is 0 (AC off), then Active Power (P) must 0.
sanity.actionDesc: Violation of this logic will cause the data row to be deleted.

split.label: Data Splitting
split.question: Time-Based Split
split.p1: After the dataset is clean, a division is performed using the Time-Based Split method (not random).
split.note: This method is realistic for simulating future modeling based on the past.
